# Hubbly

> Hubbly is an Autonomous Revenue OS. 12 AI agents — organized in 3 layers (Understand, Execute, Improve) sharing one operating memory — turn any website into pipeline via market research, ICP creation, contact enrichment, multi-channel email + voice outreach, and meeting booking.

Primary keywords: autonomous revenue OS, AI sales automation, AI SDR, autonomous outbound, lead generation automation, AI voice agent, ICP enrichment.

Primary verticals: mortgage, insurance, financial services, marketing/sales agencies.

- [Platform](https://hubbly.io/platform): The 12 agents, 3 layers, and shared memory architecture.
- [Pricing](https://hubbly.io/pricing): Plans, tiers, and the Business tier with Meta ads.
